beginner.headline: Drone Attack Leaves Eight Crew Missing in Black Sea
beginner.brief: Drones hit a ship near the coast of Romania. The ship reported a fire on Thursday morning. Four crew members are alive. However, eight people are still missing. Two helicopters and two boats are looking for them. The rescue teams are working in very high waves. The ship was travelling from Tunisia to Romania.

intermediate.headline: Eight Missing After Drone Attack on Black Sea Tanker
intermediate.brief: Eight of 12 crew members are missing after a drone attack left a tanker ablaze off Romania's coast. The vessel, named the Wine Trader, reported blasts and a fire on Thursday morning. A search and rescue operation for the missing members of the Wine Trader continues. The priority is now to reach the four crew members confirmed to be alive. The west coast of the Black Sea has recently seen a spate of drone attacks. The leaders of Romania and Bulgaria are due to discuss shortly whether Article 4 of the Nato treaty should be invoked. This allows any member of the military alliance to request consultations with its allies if it believes its security is threatened. Moscow says it is targeting ships delivering weapons and dual-use cargo to Ukrainian ports. Kyiv and its European allies say merchant vessels carrying grain and other civilian cargo are being attacked.

advanced.headline: Drone Attack on Black Sea Tanker Prompts Regional NATO Talks
advanced.brief: Naval authorities state that eight of twelve crew members are unaccounted for after a drone strike left a tanker severely damaged off Romania's coast. A substantial search and rescue operation is currently underway in the Black Sea following this latest attack in the region. The immediate focus is to reach the four personnel confirmed alive, while safeguarding rescue teams against hazardous conditions, including very high waves. Romania's authorities have deployed Black Hawk helicopters and marine rescue boats to assist the stricken vessel. The western portion of the Black Sea has witnessed numerous incidents, and a Russian drone swarm was detected overnight near Ukraine's Snake Island. Earlier in the week, another commercial ship sank further south along the Bulgarian coast following a drone strike, leaving eleven additional sailors missing. In response to that suspected attack, Bulgaria officially summoned the Russian envoy to address the mounting crisis. Consequently, Romanian and Bulgarian leaders are scheduled to deliberate shortly on whether to trigger Article 4 of the NATO treaty. This diplomatic mechanism permits any member state to demand formal discussions if its territorial integrity or national security is perceived to be under threat. Meanwhile, Moscow maintains that it strikes vessels delivering weaponry or dual-use cargo to Ukrainian ports. Conversely, European leaders emphatically condemn the strikes, warning that the Black Sea is becoming another front of escalation in the conflict.
